parents.title: Try the real thing together
parents.lead: Open the same games, lessons and resources that are used in real classrooms — not cut-down samples. Try one together and see what fits today; nothing here assumes a good week.
parents.closing: If you are not sure where to start, pick one thing and let it lead. Nothing here needs planning, and you can stop whenever it stops being useful.

trusts.title: Start with what you need to compare across schools
trusts.lead: Open the live materials behind each route and judge the curriculum, tools and accessibility from the work itself, across more than one school context. Nothing here has been approved, adopted or measured for you — that judgement is yours.
trusts.closing: If it is worth a longer look, open the same routes alongside one of your school leads and compare what each of you notices. Everything is readable before anyone's time is committed to it.

schools.title: Start with what your setting is carrying
schools.lead: Go straight to the lessons, tools and resources and judge them against the pupils, routines and pressures you already know. This was built inside an SEMH alternative provision, which tells you where it came from and nothing about whether it will fit your setting.
schools.closing: Take one route into a planning conversation and see whether it survives contact with your class. That is the only test that counts.

councils.kicker: For the question in front of you
councils.title: Start with the question you are being asked
councils.lead: Open the live materials behind each route and see what is already available to schools and settings, without waiting for a brochure or a summary. Treat it as work to look at, not as commissioned provision, approval or a compliance position.
councils.closing: If any of it is useful, it is already there for the settings you work with. Nothing needs arranging first.

partners.title: Start with the part of the work you know best
partners.lead: Open the live games, apps, tools and resources and judge the work in the area closest to yours. Looking commits nobody to anything, and no relationship follows from reading it.
partners.closing: Judge it on the area you know best and take what is useful. Nothing here needs an agreement in place first.
